iucnSource: AviList v2026 IUCN category, only where that IOC 15.2 species is the same concept (crosswalk relation same or renamed, and concept unchanged).
chinaSource: 国家重点保护野生动物名录（2021年调整）. Matched by exact scientific name, checklist synonym, unique Chinese name plus the same epithet, or a unique epithet. Unmatched names are omitted.
sanSource: 有重要生态、科学、社会价值的陆生野生动物名录（国家林业和草原局公告2023年第17号，2023年6月26日公布，2023年6月30日发布）. Birds only. Matched by exact scientific name, a checklist synonym when that name does not point at a different Chinese species, or a unique Chinese name plus the same epithet. Entries noted 仅限野外种群 are the wild population. Unmatched names and conflicts are omitted.
